$comment: ESDV-2101 emergency shutdown valve twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from SRS, FMEDA and actuator sizing data; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.description: Unit feed emergency shutdown valve, final element of SIF-2101 (high-high feed pressure)
identification.valve: 12 in ASME Class 600 trunnion-mounted ball valve, fire-safe, fail-close
identification.actuator: Pneumatic scotch-yoke spring-return actuator (spring to close)
identification.controller: SIS digital valve controller with partial stroke test and valve signature (for example Emerson Fisher DVC6200 SIS)

sif.name: SIF-2101 high-high feed pressure: close ESDV-2101
sif.source: Safety requirements specification (SRS) of the SIF. Sensor (2oo3 transmitters) and logic-solver PFDavg: assumption: typical value, replace with your FMEDA certificate / sizing sheet

reliability.source: Dangerous undetected failure rate of valve + actuator + SOV, PST coverage (PSTC) and proof test coverage (PTC): assumption: typical value, replace with your FMEDA certificate / sizing sheet. PST monthly, proof test at the 4-year turnaround, overhaul (mission time) every 10 years.

signature.source: Actuator spring and valve friction expressed in actuator pressure (bar): spring equivalent pressure at the open position (bench set), friction = f0 + k x line pressure (trunnion seats are pressure-energised), spring torque at the end of the closing stroke / at the start (scotch yoke), torque to seat / running friction torque: assumption: typical value, replace with your FMEDA certificate / sizing sheet

stroke.source: Factory acceptance test closing time and PST setup of the digital valve controller: assumption: typical value, replace with your FMEDA certificate / sizing sheet

points.label: Lowest travel reached in the last PST
Actuator pressure when the valve starts to close
Actuator pressure when the valve is back open
Line pressure during the last PST
Hours since the last successful PST
Mean interval between successful PSTs, last 12 months
Hours since the last full proof test
Hours since the last overhaul (as new)
Closing time of the last full stroke (trip or test)

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

stem_seat_sticking.name: Stem / seat sticking (galling, deposits, packing)
stem_seat_sticking.symptoms: friction up, torque margin down, closing slower, later PST fails

spring_relaxation.name: Actuator spring relaxation or breakage
spring_relaxation.symptoms: signature shifts down, friction unchanged, torque margin down

air_supply_low.name: Instrument air supply low
air_supply_low.symptoms: supply pressure close to the pressure needed to hold the valve open

position_feedback.name: Limit switch or travel sensor fault

pst_not_run.name: Partial stroke tests skipped or failing
pst_not_run.symptoms: PST age and achieved interval grow, PFDavg drifts
